It's Maria Garcia, the family medicine one, not the pediatrician.
Dr. Maria Garcia in Family Medicine practices at three locations: Midtown Medical Group, Richmond Care Center, and North Beach Specialty Center. Which location would you prefer for your checkup?
Midtown works best.

You have three options for appointments with Dr. Maria Garcia at Midtown Medical Group: New Patient Consultation, New Patient Visit, or an Annual Physical. Which one would you like to book?
An annual physical.

I'll take the 8:30 AM appointment.
Your Annual Physical with Dr. Maria Garcia at Midtown Medical Group is scheduled for Tuesday, October 27th at 8:30 AM. Can you confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm a new patient and I'd like a checkup with Dr. Garcia.
Dr. Maria Garcia practices both Pediatrics and Family Medicine. Are you looking for the pediatrician at Mission Bay, or the family medicine provider at North Beach, Midtown, or Richmond?
It's Maria Garcia, the family medicine one, not the pediatrician.
What kind of appointment would you like with Dr. Maria Garcia? Your options are New Patient Consultation, New Patient Visit, or an Annual Physical.
An annual physical.
Where would you like to have your annual physical with Dr. Maria Garcia: North Beach, Midtown, or Richmond?
Midtown works best.
I have three available times on Tuesday, October 27th: eight thirty, nine o'clock, or nine thirty in the morning. Which time works best for you?
Nine o'clock works best for me.
You have an Annual Physical booked with Dr. Maria Garcia at the Midtown Medical Group on Tuesday, October twenty-seventh at nine o'clock in the morning. Does this look good to you?
Yes, that looks good to me.

You're all set! Your Annual Physical with Dr. Maria Garcia is confirmed for Tuesday, October twenty-seventh at nine o'clock in the morning at Midtown Medical Group. Your confirmation number is B K dash E 9 1 F 6 C E 2. Anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you! Goodbye.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I assist you today?
I need an MRI of my knee with Dr. Ramirez.

The Dr. Linda Ramirez you mentioned is a cardiologist and doesn't offer an MRI of the knee. Dr. Linda Ramirez in radiology, however, or Dr. Hannah Nguyen can help with that. Do you have a referral on file for the MRI?
My doctor sent the referral already. I'd like to go with Dr. Linda Ramirez in radiology for the MRI.
Great choice. Just to confirm, since the referral is already sent, you're all set for the MRI with Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center. Are you a new patient with us?
Yes, I've been seen there before.
Dr. Linda Ramirez offers the MRI at Downtown Health Center. Does that location work for you?
Yes, that location works for me.
We have available times for the MRI on Wednesday, October twenty-first at nine thirty A-M, eleven A-M, and eleven forty-five A-M. Do any of these times work for you?
Yes, I’ll take the appointment at nine thirty A-M.
You've booked an MRI of your knee with Dr. Linda Ramirez at the Downtown Health Center on Wednesday, October twenty-first at nine thirty A-M. Can you confirm this appointment, please?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

Your appointment is confirmed for an MRI of the knee with Dr. Linda Ramirez at the Downtown Health Center on Wednesday, October twenty-first at nine thirty A-M. Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, dash, D as in Delta, one, F as in Foxtrot, B as in Bravo, C as in Charlie, eight, two, zero. Thank you for choosing us! Goodbye.

Yes, I've been seen there before.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the scheduling assistant for the clinic. How can I help you today?
Can I get a knee MRI?
I'll help you with that. Are you an existing patient at the clinic?
Yes, I am an existing patient.
To book an MRI for your spine, we need to ensure you have a referral on file. Do you have one?
Yes, I have a referral.
Which provider would you like for your MRI? You can choose Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center or Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group.
Midtown, please.
We have openings for the MRI on Monday, October nineteenth at eight AM, nine AM, and twelve PM. Which time works best for you?
I'll take the eight AM appointment, please.
You've booked an MRI of the spine with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight AM. Can you confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

Your appointment for an MRI of the spine with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight AM is now booked. Your confirmation number is B-K-eight-two-F-five-A-eight-one-E. Thank you for calling, and have a great day! Goodbye!

transcript.text: Hello! I'm the scheduling assistant for the clinic network. How can I assist you today?
Can I get a knee MRI?
Do you have a referral on file for the MRI of the spine?
Yes, I have a referral.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient with us?
I'm an existing patient.
Which provider would you like for your spine MRI: Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center or Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group?
Midtown, please.
Dr. Hannah Nguyen offers the MRI at Midtown Medical Group. Does that location work for you?
Yes, that location works for me.
We have openings for the spine MRI on Monday, October 19th at 8:00 AM, 9:00 AM, and 12:00 PM. Would any of these times work for you?
I think you meant a knee MRI, but I’d like the appointment at 8:00 AM, please.
You're scheduled for a spine MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October 19th at 8:00 AM. Do you confirm this appointment?
I would like to confirm for the knee MRI, please.
Thank you for confirming. I will proceed with booking your knee MRI appointment for Monday, October 19th at 8:00 AM.
Thank you!
Your appointment for the knee MRI is booked with confirmation number B as in Boy, K as in Kite, hyphen, E, E, four, E, C, zero, four, six. Thank you and have a great day, goodbye!

transcript.text: Hello, this is the clinic's scheduling assistant. How may I help you today?
Can I get a knee MRI?
Do you have a referral on file for an MRI of the spine?
Yes, I have a referral.
Have you been seen at our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I'm an existing patient.
Which provider would you prefer for your MRI of the spine: Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center or Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group?
Midtown, please.
We have openings for the MRI on Monday, October nineteenth at eight in the morning, nine in the morning, and twelve noon. Which time works best for you?
I can do the nine in the morning.
You have an MRI of the spine booked with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group for Monday, October nineteenth at nine in the morning. Do you confirm this appointment?
I need a knee MRI, not a spine MRI.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the scheduling assistant for the clinic. How can I assist you today?
I need an echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at the Richmond clinic.

Let's start the booking process for you. An echocardiogram requires imaging, which isn't available at Richmond Care Center. Dr. David Chen offers this service at the Mission District Family Clinic and the Downtown Health Center. Would you like to choose one of these locations?
If Richmond can't, Downtown is fine.
Do you have a referral on file for the echocardiogram?
I have a referral from my cardiologist.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I am an existing patient; I have been seen at these clinics before.
I have three slots available on Monday, October nineteenth: eight forty-five, nine thirty, and ten fifteen in the morning. Do any of these times work for you?
The eight forty-five slot works for me.
You have an appointment for an echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at the Downtown Health Center, on Monday, October nineteenth at eight forty-five in the morning. Can you confirm this?
Yes, I can confirm that appointment.

Your appointment is booked with Dr. David Chen for an echocardiogram at the Downtown Health Center on Monday, October nineteenth at eight forty-five in the morning. Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, dash, seven, eight, F as in Foxtrot, F as in Foxtrot, three, A as in Alpha, nine, five. Thank you and goodbye!

I need an echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at the Richmond clinic.

An echocardiogram needs imaging, which the Richmond Care Center doesn't have. Dr. David Chen offers it at the Mission District Family Clinic or Downtown Health Center. Would you like to book at one of these locations?
If Richmond can't, Downtown is fine.
Do you have a referral on file for the echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at Downtown Health Center?
I have a referral from my cardiologist.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I am an existing patient; I have been seen at these clinics before.
I have three available slots with Dr. David Chen on Monday, October 19: 8:45 AM, 9:30 AM, or 10:15 AM. Which time works best for you?
I'll take the 8:45 AM slot, please.
You have an echocardiogram appointment with Dr. David Chen at Downtown Health Center on Monday, October 19 at 8:45 AM. Can you confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

I'd like a teeth cleaning at North Gate.
I'll check on that for you. North Gate doesn't offer dental services, but Mission District Family Clinic can accommodate a dental cleaning. Would that location work for you?
It has to be North Gate, I can't get anywhere else.
A member of our clinic staff will contact you to assist further with your dental service needs at North Gate. Thank you for calling, and have a great day! Goodbye.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
I'd like a teeth cleaning at North Gate.

Dental Cleaning requires dental facilities, which are not available at North Gate Health Center. However, you can book this service at the Mission District Family Clinic with options Dr. Wei Lee or Dr. Lucas Singh. Which provider would you prefer?
It has to be North Gate, I can't get anywhere else.
A member of the clinic staff will call you back to help with this. Thank you for reaching out, and have a great day! Goodbye.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I assist you today?
I'm new here and need to see an OB/GYN.
I'll help with that right away. Let's see what options we have for OB/GYN appointments. What kind of OB/GYN appointment would you like? Options for new patients include a consultation or a visit.
I would like to schedule a consultation.
Which provider would you prefer for your New Patient Consultation? We have Dr. Maria Garcia in Pediatrics, Dr. Maria Garcia in Family Medicine, or Dr. Wei Chen in Internal Medicine.
I’m sorry, but I'm looking for an OB/GYN. Can you help me find one?
Unfortunately, I cannot help with an OB/GYN appointment. I recommend speaking with the clinic staff for further assistance.
I understand. Please have someone call me back when they can help with scheduling an OB/GYN appointment. Thank you!

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
I need an x-ray. I haven't been to your clinics before.
I'll get started on booking that x-ray for you. Would you like to know which locations offer x-rays?
I have a referral.
X-Ray is available only for existing patients. As a new patient, you might consider a Mammogram or another initial appointment. Would you like assistance from our staff to find the right option?
I only need an x-ray.
A member of our clinic staff will call you back to assist with your x-ray request. Thank you for reaching out, and have a great day! Goodbye!

transcript.text: Hello, this is the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
I need an x-ray. I haven't been to your clinics before.

I see that an X-Ray is only available for existing patients. As a new patient, you might consider starting with a different appointment type, such as a Mammogram. Would you like to proceed with that or need assistance from our staff?
I have a referral.
Even with a referral, new patients can't have an X-Ray as their first appointment. How about booking a Mammogram instead?
I only need an x-ray.
I understand. Since an X-Ray is only available for existing patients, I can connect you with our clinic staff to help with your specific needs. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, please.
A member of the clinic staff will call you back soon to assist you with this. Thank you for your patience, and have a great day. Goodbye!

I'd like to schedule a mammogram, I'm a new patient.
We have Mammogram appointments available with Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center and Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group. Which provider would you prefer?
Downtown is closest to me. I'll go with Dr. Linda Ramirez.
We have openings for a Mammogram with Dr. Linda Ramirez on Wednesday, October 21 at 8, 9, or 9:30 AM. Which time would you like to book?
I’d like to book the 9 AM appointment.
You're all set for a Mammogram with Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center on Wednesday, October 21 at 9 AM. Can you please confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I assist you today?
I need an eye exam.
Unfortunately, we currently don't have providers offering eye exams. Would you like assistance from our clinic staff to explore other options?
No, I would just like to schedule an eye exam.
A member of our clinic staff will call you back to help with scheduling the eye exam. Thank you for reaching out, and have a great day! Goodbye.

I need an eye exam.
Unfortunately, we don't currently have a provider offering Eye Exams. Would you like help with booking another service, or should I connect you with our clinic staff for more options?
No, I only need the eye exam.
A member of our clinic staff will call you back to assist with this. Thank you for calling, and have a great day! Goodbye.

transcript.text: Hello! I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
Can I get a skin cancer screening with Dr. Kim?
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or would you be a new patient?
I've been seen at these clinics before.
Great! Which location do you prefer for your screening: North Beach Specialty Center, Downtown Health Center, or Midtown Medical Group?
Sunset, please.
The Sunset Community Clinic doesn't offer dermatology services. You can choose between North Beach Specialty Center, Downtown Health Center, or Midtown Medical Group. Which one would you prefer?
I'll go with North Beach Specialty Center.
We have availability on Wednesday, October twenty-first at nine, ten, and ten-thirty in the morning. Do any of these times work for you?
I can do ten-thirty in the morning.
You've booked a skin cancer screening with Dr. Kenji Kim at North Beach Specialty Center on Wednesday, October twenty-first, at ten-thirty in the morning. Can you please confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.
Your appointment is booked successfully. Your confirmation number is B-K-dash-2-1-E-1-E-7-F-A. Thank you for choosing our service. Goodbye!

Sunset, please.
Dr. Kenji Kim doesn't offer skin cancer screenings at Sunset Community Clinic. Would you like to choose another location, such as North Beach Specialty Center or Downtown Health Center?
I’ll go with North Beach Specialty Center.
We have available appointments on Wednesday, October 21st at 9 AM, 10 AM, and 10:30 AM. Which time works best for you?
I'll take the 9 AM appointment, please.
You're all set for a skin cancer screening with Dr. Kenji Kim at North Beach Specialty Center on Wednesday, October 21st at 9 AM. Can you please confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

transcript.text: Hello! I'm the scheduling assistant for the clinic. How can I assist you today?
I want an annual physical with Dr. Chen.
I can help with that. Are you referring to Dr. David Chen, Dr. Daniel Chen, or Dr. Wei Chen?
I'm referring to Lucas Chen, my family doctor.
Have you been seen at our clinics before, or would this be your first visit as a new patient?
I've been seen at the clinics before.
Dr. Lucas Chen offers the Annual Physical at Mission Bay Health Center. Does this location work for you?
Yes, that location works for me.
I found available times for an Annual Physical on Monday, October 19th at 8:00 AM, 8:30 AM, and 9:30 AM. Do any of these times work for you, or is there a specific day or time you prefer?
I'll take the first option, 8:00 AM on October 19th.
You have an Annual Physical with Dr. Lucas Chen at Mission Bay Health Center scheduled for Monday, October 19th at 8:00 AM. Can you please confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

Your appointment is booked for an Annual Physical with Dr. Lucas Chen at Mission Bay Health Center on Monday, October 19th at 8:00 AM. Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, hyphen F as in Foxtrot, six, three, D as in Delta, five, eight, B as in Bravo, six. Thank you for calling, and goodbye!

Annual physical with Dr. Sarah Martinez downtown, please. I've been there before.

Oh wait, actually I've never been seen there, I'm a new patient.

Since you're a new patient, Dr. Sarah Martinez is not accepting new patients at the moment. Would you like to see Dr. Michael Chen, Dr. Priya Williams, or Dr. Nina Nguyen at Downtown Health Center instead?
Anyone downtown is fine then.
Dr. Michael Chen is available for an Annual Physical at Downtown Health Center on Monday, October 26 at eight, eight thirty, and nine in the morning. Do any of these times work for you?
Eight thirty works for me.
Confirming the appointment: Annual Physical with Dr. Michael Chen at Downtown Health Center, on Monday, October 26 at eight thirty in the morning. Does that sound good to you?
Yes, that sounds good.

Your appointment is booked for an Annual Physical with Dr. Michael Chen at Downtown Health Center on Monday, October 26 at eight thirty in the morning. Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, dash, 7, 1, 7, E as in Echo, 4, D as in Delta, 0, E as in Echo. Thank you for calling, and have a great day! Goodbye!

I need an echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at Mission District.
Do you have a referral on file for the Echocardiogram?
Yes, I have a referral from my doctor.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I am an existing patient; I've been seen at your clinics before.
I have a few time slots available on Monday, October 19th: 8 a.m., 8:45 a.m., and 9:30 a.m. Do any of these work for you?
Midtown is fine.

Actually, just an EKG.
I have a few time slots for an EKG with Dr. David Chen on Monday, October 19th: at 8 a.m., 8:20 a.m., and 8:40 a.m. Which time works for you?
I'll take the 8 a.m. slot.

Sorry, I meant a knee MRI.
Dr. David Chen doesn't offer knee MRIs. This service is available with Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center or Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group. Which provider do you prefer?
Midtown is fine. I'll go with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group.
I have times available on Monday, October 19th for an MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at 8 a.m., 8:45 a.m., and 11:45 a.m. Which one would you like?
I'll take the 8 a.m. slot.
You've scheduled an MRI for your knee with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October 19th at 8 a.m. Can you confirm this?
Yes, I can confirm that. Thank you!

Your appointment for an MRI of the knee with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October 19th at 8 a.m. is booked. Your confirmation number is B-K-zero-A-five-F-three-E-B-C. Thank you for booking and have a great day! Goodbye!

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How may I assist you today?
I need an echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at Mission District.
Let's see about scheduling the echocardiogram with Dr. David Chen at the Mission District. I'll check what's available. One moment.
Sure, thank you!
For the Echocardiogram, do you have a referral on file?
Yes, I have a referral from my doctor.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I am an existing patient; I have been seen at your clinics before.
We have openings for an echocardiogram on Monday, October 19th at eight, eight forty-five, and nine thirty in the morning. Do any of these times work for you?
Actually, just an EKG.
For an EKG, we have times available on Monday, October 19th at eight AM, eight twenty AM, and eight forty AM. Do any of these work for you?
Midtown is fine.

Dr. David Chen doesn't practice at Midtown Medical Group. You can choose a different provider at Midtown, or a location where Dr. Chen is available, like Mission Bay or Downtown Health Center. Which would you prefer?
Sorry, I meant a knee MRI.
For a knee MRI, would you like to see Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center or Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group?
I'll go with Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center.
Dr. Linda Ramirez has availability for a knee MRI on Wednesday, October 21st at nine thirty, eleven, or eleven forty-five AM. Which time would you like?
I'll take the eleven AM slot.
You've booked an MRI for your knee with Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown Health Center on Wednesday, October 21st at eleven AM. Would you like to confirm this appointment?
Yes, please confirm the appointment.

Your MRI for your knee with Dr. Linda Ramirez is confirmed for Wednesday, October 21st at eleven AM at Downtown Health Center. Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, dash F as in Foxtrot, C as in Charlie, D as in Delta, one, three, F as in Foxtrot, four, C as in Charlie. Thank you for choosing us and have a great day! Goodbye!

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the scheduling assistant at the healthcare clinic network. How can I help you today?
Knee MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown.
Do you have a referral on file for a knee MRI?
Yes, I have a referral from my doctor.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I've been seen at the clinics before.
Which provider would you like for your knee MRI, Dr. Linda Ramirez at Downtown or Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown?
Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown.
I have openings for an MRI on Monday, October nineteenth at either eight A M, eight forty-five A M, or eleven forty-five A M. Do any of these times work for you?
OK, Midtown then. I'll take the first available time, eight A M.
You're scheduled for an MRI for your knee with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at the Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight A M. Can you confirm?
Could it be at Mission Bay instead?

Unfortunately, Mission Bay Health Center doesn't have imaging, which is required for the MRI. We can still schedule at Midtown Medical Group with Dr. Hannah Nguyen. Would you like to proceed with that, or need further assistance?
I'll stick with Midtown then. Yes, let's proceed with that appointment.
I have the same openings for an MRI at Midtown: Monday, October nineteenth at eight A M, eight forty-five A M, or eleven forty-five A M. Would you like to stick with the eight A M time?
Yes, I'll stick with the eight A M time.
You're set for an MRI for your knee with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight A M. Can you confirm this is correct?
Yes, I confirm that appointment is correct.

Your MRI appointment is booked for Monday, October nineteenth at eight A M with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group. Your confirmation number is B K dash B three four one seven three three E. Thank you and have a great day! Goodbye.

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
Knee MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown.
First, let's confirm the service. Are you looking for an MRI for the knee specifically?
Yes, that's correct. A knee MRI.

Unfortunately, Dr. Hannah Nguyen can't conduct an MRI as she doesn't offer radiology services or have the required imaging capabilities at Midtown Medical Group. Would you like to book an MRI at a location with imaging capabilities instead, or would you prefer to speak with someone at the clinic for assistance?
Could it be at Mission Bay instead?
Mission Bay Health Center can perform MRIs, but Dr. Hannah Nguyen doesn't practice there. Would you like to proceed with a different radiologist available at Mission Bay for your knee MRI?
Yes, that sounds good. Who would be available for the knee MRI at Mission Bay?
Dr. Hannah Nguyen practices radiology at Mission Bay Health Center and can conduct a knee MRI. Would you like to book with her?
OK, Midtown then.

Let's find another radiologist available at Midtown for a knee MRI. Please give me a moment. Great, we can proceed with an MRI for the knee at Midtown Medical Group with Dr. Hannah Nguyen. Do you have a referral on file for this MRI?
Yes, I have a referral from my doctor.
Thanks for confirming the referral. Have you been seen at any of our clinics before, or would this be your first visit?
I've been seen at these clinics before.

We have several options for a knee MRI at Midtown Medical Group with Dr. Hannah Nguyen: Monday, October nineteenth at eight, eight forty-five, or eleven forty-five in the morning. Do any of these times work for you?
I'll take the eight o'clock appointment.
To confirm, you're booking a knee MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight in the morning. Is that correct?
Could it be at Mission Bay instead?

An MRI at Mission Bay Health Center isn't possible as it lacks imaging capabilities needed for a knee MRI. However, Dr. Hannah Nguyen can perform it at Midtown Medical Group. Would you like to proceed with that?
Yes, I'll stick with the appointment at Midtown then.
We have appointments available on Monday, October nineteenth at eight, eight forty-five, or eleven forty-five in the morning for the knee MRI at Midtown Medical Group. Which time would you prefer?
I'll take the eight o'clock appointment.
To confirm, you're booking a knee MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight in the morning. Is that correct?
Yes, that is correct.

Your knee MRI with Dr. Hannah Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group is booked for Monday, October nineteenth at eight in the morning. Your confirmation number is BK dash one one C C six three E F. Thank you for scheduling with us, and have a great day! Goodbye.

I'd like a flu shot.
Have you been seen at one of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I've been seen at the clinics before.
Which provider would you like for your flu shot: Dr. Maria Garcia (MD, Pediatrics) at Mission Bay Health Center, Dr. Maria Garcia (NP, Family Medicine), or Dr. Wei Chen (DO, Internal Medicine)?
I'll go with Dr. Maria Garcia (MD, Pediatrics) at Mission Bay Health Center.
I have openings for a flu shot on Monday, October nineteenth at eight AM, eight ten AM, and eight twenty AM. Do any of these times work for you?
Eight AM works for me.
You've booked a flu shot with Dr. Maria Garcia at the Mission Bay Health Center on Monday, October nineteenth at eight AM. Can you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

Yes, that location works for me.
I have openings for a flu shot with Dr. Lucas Chen today at eight AM, eight ten AM, and eight twenty AM. Do any of these times work for you?
Actually, the second time you mentioned is better.

Yes, I can confirm that appointment.

transcript.text: Hello! I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
A flu shot with Dr. Lucas Chen, please.
Have you been seen at any of our clinics before, or are you a new patient?
I've been seen at these clinics before.
Dr. Lucas Chen can provide a flu shot at Mission Bay Health Center. Does that location work for you?
Yes, that location works for me.
Great! We have openings with Dr. Lucas Chen on Monday, October nineteenth at eight AM, eight ten AM, and eight twenty AM. Which time works for you?
Actually, the second time you mentioned is better.
You'll have a flu shot with Dr. Lucas Chen at Mission Bay Health Center on Monday, October nineteenth at eight ten AM. Can you confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

Your appointment is booked! Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, dash, nine, nine, C as in Charlie, A as in Alpha, F as in Foxtrot, zero, D as in Delta, three. Thank you and have a great day! Goodbye!

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I assist you today?
I need to get blood work done at the Mission clinic.

Blood work cannot be scheduled at Mission District Family Clinic because it lacks the necessary lab capability. However, it can be done with Dr. Leila Sato at Mission Bay Health Center. Would you like to proceed with this option?
Yes, I’d like to proceed with that option.
We have available slots for blood work on Wednesday, October 21st at eight, eight fifteen, and eight thirty in the morning. Which time would you like?
I'll take the eight o'clock slot, please.
You've booked a blood draw with Dr. Leila Sato at Mission Bay Health Center on Wednesday, October 21st at eight AM. Can you confirm this appointment?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

Your appointment is booked for a blood draw with Dr. Leila Sato at Mission Bay Health Center on October 21st at 8:00 AM. Your confirmation number is B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, dash, six, A as in Alpha, B as in Bravo, three, F as in Foxtrot, seven, A as in Alpha, F as in Foxtrot. Thank you for choosing our clinic. Goodbye!

Yes, please proceed.

I'll take the first option, eight thirty in the morning.
You're booked for a flu shot with Dr. Nina Nguyen at Midtown Medical Group on Monday, October nineteenth at eight thirty in the morning. Can you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm the appointment.

I'll go with eight thirty.

Your flu shot with Dr. Nina Nguyen is scheduled at Midtown Medical Group for Tuesday, October twentieth at eight thirty in the morning. Can you confirm this appointment?

transcript.text: Hello, I'm the clinic's scheduling assistant. How can I assist you today?
Hi, do you do allergy testing? And what about travel shots?
Yes, we offer both allergy testing and travel vaccinations. Which service would you like to book?
I don't have a referral. Then let's just do a flu shot at the Sunset clinic, with whoever is available.
Are you a new patient at our clinics, or have you seen one of our providers before?
I've been to your clinics before.
For the flu shot at Sunset Community Clinic, would you prefer Dr. Priya Ramirez, Dr. Michael Sato, or Dr. Fatima Patel?
I'll go with whoever is available first.
I have available times for your flu shot on Friday, October 23rd at eight, eight ten, and eight twenty in the morning. Which time would you prefer?
I'll take the first one, eight o'clock.
You have an appointment for a flu shot with Dr. Priya Ramirez at the Sunset Community Clinic on Friday, October 23rd at eight in the morning. Does that sound good to you?
Yes, that sounds good.
Your appointment is booked, and your confirmation number is BK-D4F4B785. Thank you for choosing our clinic. Goodbye!
